Task1 · Native volume audit

Primary ROI remains central r≤5mm, depth15–20mm. Whole modeled XY at that depth is a separate supplement. D50mm; layers0.1/5/5/15mm; top pads,2 outputs/common return/50Ω. All numbers below are already-computed audit values in V/m, m³, A/m², W and mA. No normalization, threshold classification, native-field query or PDE runs in this page.

Volume weights: fractional central ROI; exact face-clipped depth overlap; whole modeled XY uses native staircase cells, without ideal-cylinder renormalization. Quantiles: stable inverse volume-weighted ECDF, side=left. Fundamental-only maxTIS/fixedTIS and full4-line E RMS are different quantities. fixedTIS uses direction(1/√2,1/√2,0). maxTIS uses2074 sampled directions, a lower bound to the continuous-direction maximum. RMS includes both fundamentals and both third harmonics; each source frequency is recorded below. A hotspot at a tissue interface is not evidence of deep concentration. Numerical burden/cutoff values are not human safety or activation limits.

Only reports and small input hashes were checked by this viewer. Native NPZ/grid/E/phi bytes were not opened; their hashes retain the original audit provenance. Mesh convergence, experiment and adoption remain unvalidated.

Existing common-scale maps — use that screen’s original units/normalizations (V/cm); this viewer uses stored V/m. These selectors do not create or rescale maps.

Fine XY0.625mm /SC2 /bulk14,14,40 is shared. Total physical area stays900mm², with225mm² per electrical parent group. Source drive and separate burdens

Equal current uses the sum of the two output RMS currents, including passive-frequency currents. It is bookkeeping, not common-GND return current. Skin/contact-only has8 caps without source-power or1Vpp ceilings; legacy composite adds both. A scale above1 is a numerical comparison, not a stimulation recommendation.
